The '''Orvax system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]]<ref name="DT 3" /> and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]], of which it had at least four.<ref name="DT 4" />
